title: Increasing Incidence of Drivers Going Against Traffic Flow
what_it_is: Increasing Incidence of Drivers Going Against Traffic Flow

sections.label: Traffic Police accident data and road signs
sections.summary: Traffic Police do not generally track accidents by wrong-way driving cause, but fatal accident data show three in three years; LTA uses international standards and specialist engineers for road signs and markings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: The Traffic Police does not generally track and categorise accidents by the cause of vehicles going against the flow of traffic.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: However, for fatal accidents specifically, their data show that three have occurred in the past three years as a result of this behaviour.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) takes reference from international standards in the design and installation of road signs and markings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: In addition, LTA engages independent specialist road safety engineers to review the clarity and effectiveness of our road signs and markings for new roads and undertakes regular safety audits of existing roads.

sections.label: Public feedback on specific roads
sections.summary: Public feedback is taken into account and specific roads residents have issues with are reviewed for better clarity and ease of use.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: On top of that, we also take into account public feedback and review specific roads that residents may have issues with, to lend better clarity and ease of use.
